text: A failure is not always a mistake; it may simply be the best one can do under the circumstances. The real mistake is to stop trying.
author: B. F. Skinner

text: You can't think yourself into new ways of acting; you only can act yourself into new ways of thinking.
author: Marsha Linehan

text: Nothing in life is as important as you think it is, while you are thinking about it.
author: Daniel Kahneman

text: The world makes much less sense than you think. The coherence comes mostly from the way your mind works.
author: Daniel Kahneman

text: Vulnerability is not knowing victory or defeat, it's understanding the necessity of both; it's engaging. It's being all in.
author: Brené Brown

text: It is not primarily our physical selves that limit us but rather our mindset about our physical limits.
author: Ellen J. Langer

text: Deep breathing is our nervous system's love language.
author: Lauren Fogel Mersy

text: If you deliberately plan on being less than you are capable of being, then I warn you that you'll be unhappy for the rest of your life.
author: Abraham Maslow

text: Once you start making the effort to 'wake yourself up'—that is, be more mindful in your activities—you suddenly start appreciating life a lot more.
author: Robert Biswas-Diener

text: It is a predisposition of human nature to consider an unpleasant idea untrue, and then it is easy to find arguments against it.
author: Sigmund Freud

text: On this sacred path of radical acceptance, rather than striving for perfection, we discover how to love ourselves into wholeness.
author: Tara Brach

text: Everything can be taken from a man, but the last of the human freedoms: to choose one's attitudes in any given set of circumstances.
author: Viktor Frankl

text: Happiness cannot be pursued; it must ensue.
author: Viktor E. Frankl

text: What you want is to go into the direction that you don't yet know.
author: Orna Guralnik

text: For happy people, time is 'filled and planned.' For unhappy people, time is unfilled, open, and uncommitted; they postpone things and are inefficient.
author: Michael Argyle

text: Every person on this earth is full of great possibilities that can be realized through imagination, effort, and perseverance.
author: Scott Barry Kaufman

text: Permit yourself to change your mind when something is no longer working for you.
author: Nedra Glover Tawwab

text: When we encounter an unexpected challenge or threat, the only way to save ourselves is to hold on tight to the people around us and not let go.
author: Shawn Achor

text: The truth is, bad things don't affect us as profoundly as we expect them to. That's true of good things, too. We adapt very quickly to either.
author: Daniel Gilbert

text: When we are open to new possibilities, we find them. Be open and skeptical of everything.
author: Todd Kashdan

text: Becoming is better than being.
author: Carol S. Dweck

text: People in a growth mindset don't just seek challenge, they thrive on it. The bigger the challenge, the more they stretch.
author: Carol Dweck

text: People often say that this or that person has not yet found himself. But the self is not something one finds, it is something one creates.
author: Thomas Szasz

text: Only dead people never get stressed, never get broken hearts, never experience the disappointment that comes with failure. Tough emotions are part of our contract with life.
author: Susan David

text: The good life is a process, not a state of being. It is a direction, not a destination.
author: Carl Rogers

text: The belief that one's own view of reality is the only reality is the most dangerous of all delusions.
author: Paul Watzlawick

text: …the sole purpose of human existence is to kindle a light in the darkness of mere being.
author: Carl Gustav Jung

text: Even a happy life cannot be without a measure of darkness, and the word happy would lose its meaning if it were not balanced by sadness.
author: Carl Gustav Jung

text: To find out what is truly individual in ourselves, profound reflection is needed; and suddenly we realize how uncommonly difficult the discovery of individuality is.
author: Carl Gustav Jung

text: Happiness is not out there for us to find. The reason that it's not out there is that it's inside us.
author: Sonja Lyubomirsky

text: Every criticism, judgment, diagnosis, and expression of anger is the tragic expression of an unmet need.
author: Marshall Rosenberg

text: You are worthy of love and belonging just as you are.
author: Brené Brown

text: Only when we are brave enough to explore the darkness will we discover the infinite power of our light.
author: Brené Brown

text: Vulnerability sounds like truth and feels like courage. Truth and courage aren't always comfortable, but they're never weakness.
author: Brené Brown

text: Vulnerability is not about winning, and it's not about losing. It's about having the courage to show up and be seen.
author: Brené Brown

text: Life is never made unbearable by circumstances, but only by lack of meaning and purpose.
author: Viktor E. Frankl

text: The quest for meaning is the key to mental health and human flourishing.
author: Viktor Frankl

text: You can't stop the waves, but you can learn to surf.
author: Jon Kabat-Zinn

text: Start prioritizing your mental health instead of adjusting to toxic spaces.
author: Thema Bryant-Davis

text: This revolutionary act of treating ourselves tenderly can begin to undo the aversive messages of a lifetime.
author: Tara Brach
